title: Task list shows an error screen instead of an empty state after deleting all tasks
body:
Deleting every task from the list should leave the user with an empty task list ('No tasks yet'). Instead, once the last task is removed, the screen switches to a generic error view.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Launch the app with the seeded tasks.
2. Delete tasks one at a time until none remain.
3. Observe the screen after the last task is deleted.

Expected behavior:
Once all tasks have been removed, the screen should show a friendly empty state.

Actual behavior:
The screen shows 'Failed to load tasks' and 'No tasks found in local storage' with a Retry button.

Additional context:
The bug only occurs when the list becomes empty. Deleting until one task remains works correctly. This reproduces without using refresh.
